# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

## 1. What is this project?
This is an open-source project created for learning and collaboration.

## 2. How can I contribute?
You can contribute by forking the repository, making changes, and submitting a pull request.

## 3. How can I report a problem?
You can report problems by creating an issue in the GitHub repository.

## 4. Can beginners contribute?
Yes! Beginners are welcome to contribute and learn.

## 5. Where can I find contribution guidelines?
You can find them in the CONTRIBUTING.md file.
